title: Codex exec with an explicit linked-worktree workdir once returned the main checkout's git state (HEAD and status): attribute it (Codex harness or TermAl) and fix it or document it
outcome: Codex exec with an explicit linked-worktree workdir once returned the main checkout's git state (HEAD and status): attribute it (Codex harness or TermAl) and fix it or document it
acceptance: The cause is attributed with evidence: the Codex harness's exec workdir handling, TermAl's Codex adapter or app-server integration (any cwd TermAl passes or rewrites), or git environment state such as GIT_DIR or GIT_WORK_TREE inherited by the shell. Each candidate is confirmed or excluded with file:line or a reproduction.

If TermAl is responsible, a fix with a behavioural test makes an exec with an explicit linked-worktree workdir always run there. If the cause is outside TermAl, a bounded upstream report and the agent workaround are documented in the relevant docs. No test reads the docs.
